purpose: Frozen answers of the US Naval Observatory's celestial navigation service (https://aa.usno.navy.mil/api/celnav) for the navigational stars above the horizon: Hc (computed altitude, degrees, geometric), Zn (azimuth from north through east), the apparent declination and the Greenwich hour angle. The independent reference for star positions in stars.js, as Horizons and USNO are for the Sun, Moon and planets.
note: A star is named by USNO and identified by IAU name in the catalogue; each identification was checked by the declination of date (within 0.4 degrees of the catalogue's J2000 declination).
